title: Sign height
text:
20.02.910 Sign height.
Sign height means the following:
1.	For freestanding signs, the vertical measurement between the highest part of the sign, excluding all billboard add-ons, and the ground level upon which the sign is located;
2.	For wall and all other signs, the vertical measurement of the sign area.
(Ord. 16653 § 2 (part), 2007)
(Ord. No. 17318, § 1, 5-4-2010)
